3: Attend to the voice of my supplication, my King, and my God: for to you, O Lord, will I pray.
4: In the morning you shall hear my voice: in the morning will I wait upon you, and will look up.
5: For you are not a god that desires iniquity; neither shall the worker of wickedness dwell with you.
6: Neither shall the transgressors continue in your sight: you hate, O Lord, all them that work iniquity.
7: You will destroy all that speak falsehood: the Lord abhors the bloody and deceitful man.
8: But I will enter into your house in the multitude of your mercy: I will worship in your fear toward your holy temple.
9: Lead me, O Lord, in your righteousness because of my enemies; make my way plain before your face.
10: For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain; their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit.
11: Judge them, O God; let them fail of their counsels: cast them out according to the abundance of their ungodliness; for they have provoked you, O Lord.
12: But let all that trust on you be glad in you: they shall exult for ever, and you shall dwell among them; and all that love your name shall rejoice in you.
13: For you, Lord, shall bless the righteous: you have compassed us as with a shield of favor.
